digest.component_or_area: repository-wide code, architecture, documentation, and test quality assessment
propositions: Multiple source modules exceed the documented 500-LOC complexity target, with orchestration and multi-pass functions combining unrelated concerns and creating hotspots for bugs and maintenance friction.
Global type strictness is not enforced; mypy with --disallow-untyped-defs reveals 687 errors, and only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce package-level type precision.
Documentation examples and reference pages contain stale or contradictory information about configuration, option handling, and feature availability that does not match current implementation.
CI gate reliability shows repeated worker crashes in test_opcert_service_app.py under xdist, causing spurious failures and retry latency despite patch content being correct.

External-integration test design is strong (opt-in gating, isolated fixtures, scheduled matrix), but mutation-testing evidence is stale (dated June/July 2026) and not integrated into gating workflows.
